patch_description: Restructured into a layered pipeline: (1) a RouteIndex that computes single-source Dijkstra once (instead of per-destination), (2) a SharedPrefixCache that reuses overlapping path segments to avoid redundant transfers, and (3) a partition splitter that assigns edge-disjoint/diverse paths per partition to balance load across networks. This reduces total cost by spreading partitions over parallel low-cost routes while sharing common prefixes, and improves maintainability through clear separation of concerns.
